title: SGLang Tokenizer encode wall time - review

panels.title: Tokenizer $operation wall time ($input_type)
panels.description: One sample per measured encode operation; batch invocations are not divided by batch size. Source=chat or manager. encode excludes separate template rendering and executor waiting; chat_template includes fused rendering. Each series is a 5-minute call-weighted statistic. Empty data is not zero. No TTFT denominator.

targets.expr: (sum by (model_name, source) (rate({__name__="sglang:tokenizer_encode_seconds_sum",model_name=~"$model_name",source=~"$source",input_type="$input_type",operation="$operation",result="success"}[5m])) / sum by (model_name, source) (rate({__name__="sglang:tokenizer_encode_seconds_count",model_name=~"$model_name",source=~"$source",input_type="$input_type",operation="$operation",result="success"}[5m]))) and on (model_name, source) (sum by (model_name, source) (rate({__name__="sglang:tokenizer_encode_seconds_count",model_name=~"$model_name",source=~"$source",input_type="$input_type",operation="$operation",result="success"}[5m])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (model_name, source, le) (rate({__name__="sglang:tokenizer_encode_seconds_bucket",model_name=~"$model_name",source=~"$source",input_type="$input_type",operation="$operation",result="success"}[5m]))) and on (model_name, source) (sum by (model_name, source) (rate({__name__="sglang:tokenizer_encode_seconds_count",model_name=~"$model_name",source=~"$source",input_type="$input_type",operation="$operation",result="success"}[5m])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by (model_name, source, le) (rate({__name__="sglang:tokenizer_encode_seconds_bucket",model_name=~"$model_name",source=~"$source",input_type="$input_type",operation="$operation",result="success"}[5m]))) and on (model_name, source) (sum by (model_name, source) (rate({__name__="sglang:tokenizer_encode_seconds_count",model_name=~"$model_name",source=~"$source",input_type="$input_type",operation="$operation",result="success"}[5m])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (model_name, source, le) (rate({__name__="sglang:tokenizer_encode_seconds_bucket",model_name=~"$model_name",source=~"$source",input_type="$input_type",operation="$operation",result="success"}[5m]))) and on (model_name, source) (sum by (model_name, source) (rate({__name__="sglang:tokenizer_encode_seconds_count",model_name=~"$model_name",source=~"$source",input_type="$input_type",operation="$operation",result="success"}[5m])) > 0)

panels.title: Measured successful encode calls / second
panels.description: Histogram count rate: encode operations, not HTTP requests, generated sequences or tokens.

panels.title: Failed encode calls / second
panels.description: Errors from the measured invocation only; input validation before encoding and downstream inference errors are outside this metric. Missing error series does not establish collector coverage.
